name: Portfolio Management & Order Execution
description: Management of discretionary and advisory investment portfolios, including order routing and execution via trading platforms.
impact_of_disruption: Inability to execute trades, potential market losses, breach of fiduciary duty to clients.

name: Risk Measurement & Reporting
description: Daily calculation of VaR, stress tests, liquidity risk, counterparty risk. Regulatory reporting to AMF and ESMA.
impact_of_disruption: Inability to monitor portfolio risk, potential regulatory breach, delayed supervisory reports.

name: Client Onboarding & KYC/AML
description: Client identification, verification, anti-money laundering screening, sanctions list checking, PEP identification.
impact_of_disruption: Cannot onboard new clients, potential AML violations, regulatory sanctions.

name: Fund Accounting & NAV Calculation
description: Daily net asset value calculation for all UCITS and AIF funds, reconciliation with custodian and transfer agent.
impact_of_disruption: Incorrect fund pricing, investor losses, suspension of fund subscriptions/redemptions.

name: ESG Data Integration & Reporting
description: Integration of ESG ratings, carbon footprint data, SFDR Article 8/9 compliance monitoring, PAI calculations.
impact_of_disruption: Delayed sustainability reports, potential SFDR non-compliance, reputational risk.

name: Cybersecurity & Access Management
description: Identity and access management, privileged access control, security monitoring, incident response.
impact_of_disruption: Complete security breach exposure, unauthorized system access, data exfiltration.
